Side.description: Buy Side / Sell Side, from the Registrar

Countries Override.description: Optional CSV of countries. Other Sources takes its geography from the source directory, not the ICP category; blank = use the ICP list

Fit.description: ICP fit-filter decision from scrapers_highways (KEEP / DROP). Blank = no decision = KEEP; only DROP skips the people search

Seniority Group.description: Optional: A (founder..director) or B (head..mid-level) narrows the ICP seniority list for a split search; blank = the full list
